epics.title: Accountable engineering loop
epics.objective: Enforce decision 0032 end to end: JIT frontier contracts gated at stage start, evidence-backed grills, bounded reviewable diffs.

tasks.title: Evidence records under the story directory
tasks.objective: A single story_dir() path helper routes every recorder and gate to .factory/stories/<KEY>/ for new stories, with read fallback to the legacy live singletons and history/ so existing data stays readable.
acceptance_criteria: new-story artifacts record under .factory/stories/<KEY>/ through one shared path helper
legacy live and history layouts remain readable by every consumer

tasks.title: The active-story pointer leaves version control
tasks.objective: Intake writes the pointer to .git/forge/run.json beside the protected authority; phase derives from story artifacts; tracked run.json is no longer written for new stories and stays readable for legacy ones.
acceptance_criteria: two worktrees intake different stories with zero tracked run.json writes
phase derivation matches the old run.json semantics for legacy repos

tasks.title: Events are one file each
tasks.objective: append_event writes per-event files under the story directory (0022 pattern); forge history and the board read per-event files and legacy events.jsonl together; the union-driver dependency is retired from docs.
acceptance_criteria: recording an event creates a new file and appends to no shared ledger
forge history renders legacy and per-file events in one timeline

tasks.title: pr_ready ships without moving files
tasks.objective: pr_ready marks the story shipped inside its story directory - no archive move, no rename-detection strands; board and history read shipped story dirs; roadmap done-flip unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: pr_ready completes with zero file moves and evidence stays at its recorded paths
board and forge history read shipped stories from the story directory

tasks.title: Hooks survive merges and permit scoped resolution
tasks.objective: With unmerged index entries, pre_tool_use permits git-native resolution (checkout --ours/--theirs, rm, add) for exactly those paths while refusing content hand-writes; unparseable factory_lib or state engages a static deny-list fallback instead of crashing; forge next auto-heals the roadmap after a merge commit.
acceptance_criteria: the carve-out matrix passes: resolution allowed for exactly the unmerged set, refused outside it, deny-list fallback engages on broken imports
forge next heals the roadmap after a merge without being asked

tasks.title: Legacy repos cut over at intake; clients get it via upgrade
tasks.objective: The next intake on a legacy repo starts the story-scoped layout without touching old artifacts; forge upgrade carries the change to client repos; docs sweep; the merge-simulation gate test proves two concurrent stories produce zero overlapping .factory paths.
acceptance_criteria: intake on a legacy fixture starts the new layout with old artifacts untouched and readable
the merge-simulation test merges two concurrent story branches with zero .factory conflicts
